name: Tesla
source:
Lily's Apprentice: Tesla
A young man from the land of the wind who became Lily's disciple in the previous work.
He has mixed feelings, this time unexpectedly returning to his hometown. Perhaps because he turned from a hunter to an alchemist, his dark-skinned skin turned white. He has a bright personality and is caring. He is well liked because he grows vegetables with the village children. He is close in age to Narcissus, so he is strangely on good terms with him.
He respects Lily and sees her as a woman, but...?
